'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[2022 Russian mobilization]]
****[[2022 anti-war protests in Russia]], [[2022 North Caucasian protests]]
*****Spontaneous protests against the [[mobilization]] continue in [[Dagestan]] and [[Kabardino-Balkaria]]. [https://www.kavkazr.com/a/v-dagestane-nachalisj-novye-stihiynye-mitingi-protiv-mobilizatsii/32052683.html (Radio Liberty)]
*[[Kurdish–Turkish conflict (1978–present)|Kurdish–Turkish conflict]]
**A police officer is killed and another injured during a shooting and bomb attack near a police station in [[Mersin]], [[Turkey]]. Both the attackers are killed. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/explosion-near-police-building-turkey-kills-one-police-officer-2022-09-27/ (Reuters)]
*[[Jihadist insurgency in Burkina Faso]]
**Eleven soldiers are killed as a 150-vehicle convoy carrying supplies to [[Djibo]] is ambushed by [[Islamist]] [[militant]]s in Gaskindé (Pobé-Mengao), [[Soum Province]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/several-feared-dead-trucks-destroyed-burkina-faso-convoy-attack-2022-09-27/ (Reuters)]
*Russian oligarch [[Yevgeny Prigozhin]], a close ally of [[Vladimir Putin]], publicly admits for the first time that he founded the [[Wagner Group]], a [[private military company]] accused of [[war crime]]s in places where they had been deployed. Prigozhin had previously denied any involvement with the organization. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/sep/26/putin-ally-yevgeny-prigozhin-admits-founding-wagner-mercenary-group (''The Guardian'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[September 2022 United Kingdom mini-budget]]
**The [[pound sterling]] falls to its record lowest level against the [[United States dollar|U.S. dollar]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-63030208 (BBC News)]
*[[Inter-American Development Bank]] chief [[Mauricio Claver-Carone]] is fired by the bank's board of governors after an external investigation, started because of a [[whistleblower]] complaint, found that Claver-Carone had an undisclosed intimate relationship with his subordinate and committed several ethics violations in connection with her. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/exclusive-idb-governors-vote-remove-bank-president-claver-carone-after-ethics-2022-09-26/ (Reuters)] [https://www.ft.com/content/6745c027-457a-4cae-a7d6-7f7d0e00b009 (''Financial Times'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2022 Pacific typhoon season]]
**Six people are killed as [[Typhoon Noru]] makes [[landfall]] on the island of [[Luzon]], [[Philippines]]. [https://www.npr.org/2022/09/26/1125053969/typhoon-noru-leaves-5-rescuers-dead-in-the-northern-philippines (NPR)]
*Six [[Pakistani military]] personnel are killed in a helicopter crash in [[Balochistan, Pakistan|Balochistan]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://www.barrons.com/news/six-killed-in-second-pakistan-chopper-crash-in-over-a-month-01664172606 (''Barron's'')]
*Seven people are killed in a fire in a [[shopping mall]] in [[Daejeon]], [[South Korea]]. [https://apnews.com/article/fires-seoul-south-korea-evacuations-a00790476bf541bfd30a03f79672cbc6 (AP)]
*Three people are killed in a [[building collapse]] in [[Nairobi]], [[Kenya]]. [https://apnews.com/article/africa-accidents-kenya-nairobi-building-collapses-cae6ec3d3056f832c77272286e0b414d (AP)]
*Four people are killed after a boat sinks in the [[Galápagos Islands]], [[Ecuador]]. [https://apnews.com/article/ecuador-charles-darwin-galapagos-islands-221deac1c8e4af2f53351ee56ac44bc1 (AP)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Germany]]
***[[Chancellor of Germany|Chancellor]] [[Olaf Scholz]] tests positive for [[COVID-19]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/german-chancellor-scholz-tests-positive-coronavirus-ntv-2022-09-26/ (Reuters)]
*[[2022 Uganda Ebola outbreak]]
**The death toll from an [[Zaire ebolavirus|Ebola virus]] outbreak in [[Mubende District]], [[Uganda]], increases to 23, with a total of 36 confirmed and suspected cases. [https://edition.cnn.com/2022/09/26/africa/ebola-deaths-rise-uganda-intl/index.html (CNN)]
*The death toll from the [[cholera]] outbreak in [[Syria]] increases to 29, with a total of 338 cases reported, the majority of whom are in [[Aleppo Governorate]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/9/26/syrian-health-ministry-says-cholera-death-toll-rises-to-29 (Al Jazeera)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Colombia–Venezuela relations]]
**The [[Colombia–Venezuela border]] reopens for commerce and trade after a seven-year closure. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2022-09-26/colombia-and-venezuela-re-open-border-after-years-of-hostility (Bloomberg)]
*[[Kazakhstan–Russia relations]]
**[[Kazakhstan]] says that it will not recognize the results of the [[2022 annexation referendums in Russian-occupied Ukraine|ongoing annexation referendum]]s in [[Occupied territories of Ukraine|Russian-occupied Ukraine]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/kazakhstan-says-it-wont-recognise-referendums-eastern-ukraine-2022-09-26/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Izhevsk school shooting]]
**A man kills 17 people and injures 24 others in a [[mass shooting]] at a school in [[Izhevsk]], [[Russia]], before [[suicide in Russia|killing himself]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-63032790 (BBC News)]
*[[2022 California wildfires]]
**The [[United States Forest Service]] seizes equipment owned by the [[Pacific Gas and Electric Company]], as part of a criminal investigation into the company's role in the [[Mosquito Fire]]. [https://www.reuters.com/legal/forest-service-launches-criminal-probe-into-mosquito-fire-seizes-pge-equipment-2022-09-26/ (Reuters)]
*[[Russia–United States relations]]
**[[President of Russia|President]] [[Vladimir Putin]] signs a decree granting [[Russian citizenship]] to American whistleblower [[Edward Snowden]]. [https://amp.theguardian.com/us-news/2022/sep/26/putin-grants-russian-citizenship-to-us-whistleblower-edward-snowden (''The Guardian'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2022 Cuban Family Code referendum]]
**A referendum is approved in [[Cuba]], granting, among other things, broader rights for the [[LGBT community]], including [[same-sex marriage|marriage]]. [https://time.com/6216660/cuba-approves-same-sex-marriage/ (''Time'')]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Double Asteroid Redirection Test]]
**[[NASA]]'s DART spacecraft successfully impacts [[Dimorphos]] at 23:16 [[UTC]], becoming the first spacecraft to impact an [[asteroid]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/us/live-news/dart-nasa-asteroid-mission/index.html (CNN)]
